admission.unsupportedVersions: unknown, malformed or missing pin/copy rejects; no default fallback

timing.ownership: candidate only; existing Force/Third-Out/Runner Settlement remains only formal authority

timing.ordinaryEffort: S8 effort insufficient remains unchanged; no calibration source/no official E or would-be A
